releases.notes: Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol and exact release packaging. Remote upgrades require Linux/systemd, the upgrade helper, and unchanged state schema 9. Docker uses container-managed updates. Docker and Windows end-to-end installation has not been verified.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol and exact release packaging. The Linux installer adds six-stage terminal feedback, TTY download progress and bounded active/running process checks; startup does not prove PSP sync, core or proxy readiness. Remote upgrades require Linux/systemd, the upgrade helper, and unchanged state schema 9. Docker uses container-managed updates. Docker and Windows end-to-end installation has not been verified.
Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, pn management workflow, Docker remote upgrades and exact release packaging. Manual packages cover Linux, macOS and Windows on amd64 and arm64.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, exact release packaging and managed Docker upgrades. The public Linux installer defaults to Stable, supports explicit Beta and install-only modes, and can install from an already verified offline release package. Container startup and Agent logs include timestamps and actionable credential/data mount diagnostics.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, exact release packaging and managed Docker upgrades. Docker deployments use explicit project directories: ./config for the read-only credential, ./data for persistent writable state, and ./upgrades only when the updater is enabled. This avoids NAS Compose implementations creating a missing file bind source as a directory.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, exact release packaging and managed Docker upgrades. Docker startup now uses BusyBox-compatible ownership repair for the ./data directory; the published Alpine image is acceptance-tested with the documented ./config and ./data directory bind mounts.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, exact release packaging and managed Docker upgrades. The v1 report contract gains host telemetry: CPU, memory, disk, network and load are collected on the Node side without root. Core process identity is published as a verifiable handle, and agent logs adopt the panel's Xray line format.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, exact release packaging and managed Docker upgrades. Adds the diagnostics.collect.v1 contract and the remote diagnostic that answers it, carrying the four events a diagnostic records. Supersedes v0.0.1-beta10, which panics when a host report has no network section.
